summary.text: Mike Schietzelt is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 35 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A Marine Corps veteran and attorney, he faces Democrat Evonne S. Hopkins in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Schietzelt graduated from Western Alamance High School and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2011 to 2015.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2008 and a law degree from Duke University School of Law in 2018, and he has worked as an attorney.
Schietzelt assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Terence Everitt.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in a single-parent household and described his first term as focused on affordability, citing tax relief, regulatory reduction, and teacher pay increases.
He listed affordability, education, and infrastructure as his three key campaign messages, including continued work on the Capital Boulevard project and an emergency room in Wake Forest.
